projects.title: AgriSaarthi AI
projects.shortDescription: An AI-powered agricultural assistant designed to help farmers make better farming decisions.
projects.detailedDescription: AgriSaarthi AI is conceptualized to support agricultural communities through intelligent decision making. It evaluates critical farming parameters including crop selection compatibility, localized soil qualities, seasonal weather predictions, irrigation schedules, and agricultural risk mitigations. Built with an intuitive multilingual architecture to bridge technology accessibility for everyday farming operations.
highlights: Crop suitability recommendations based on soil N-P-K & moisture indicators
Pest & disease early risk assessment workflows

projects.title: QShield
projects.shortDescription: A quantum-inspired cybersecurity and digital-signature verification application.
projects.detailedDescription: QShield is an experimental cybersecurity prototype exploring post-quantum signature schemes and digital identity security. It simulates real-world threat vectors including message forgery, credential impersonation, replay attacks, and channel man-in-the-middle manipulation. Note: This is an analytical and cryptographic exploration tool designed to model threat defenses, not a production trained AI/ML system.
highlights: Simulation of replay attacks and cryptographic hash verification
Digital signature integrity audit against tampering vectors
Channel state validation against eavesdropping models

projects.title: Smart Blind Stick
projects.shortDescription: Arduino-based assistive navigation stick with ultrasonic obstacle detection and acoustic alerts.
projects.detailedDescription: An assistive hardware prototype designed to enhance spatial mobility and safety for visually impaired individuals. Utilizes an Arduino microcontroller paired with ultrasonic distance sensors to continuously map frontal hazards within a 2-meter proximity cone, triggering progressive buzzer frequencies to warn the user of obstacles, steps, or elevation changes.
highlights: Frequency-modulated acoustic alerting based on obstacle proximity
Lightweight ergonomic chassis with low-power battery draw
Hands-on sensor calibration and micro-soldering design

projects.title: 3D AI Universe Portfolio
projects.shortDescription: An immersive 3D personal portfolio website demonstrating development skills and technical interests.
projects.detailedDescription: A bespoke digital experience built to showcase my technical journey, coding profiles, hackathon participations, and academic milestones. Engineered with Three.js WebGL shaders, spatial lighting, real-time GitHub integration, interactive developer terminal, server-side Gemini AI assistant, and a private authenticated admin management system.

Real-time GitHub activity aggregation and coding platform links

Full admin dashboard with secure content management
